subject.title: sandbox: keep workspaceAccess none workspaces writable

question: Does the sandbox/security owner approve implementing writable isolated `/workspace` for `workspaceAccess: "none"` now that maintainers have rejected the strict tool-gate workaround?
rationale: The product direction is now clearer, but the code change still alters sandbox write authorization and CODEOWNERS routes sandbox code/docs to security review.

options.title: Approve isolated writable `none`
options.body: Implement writable sandbox-owned `/workspace` for `none`, with Docker/browser/remote bridge parity, protected-skill preservation, docs/tests, and live proof.

options.title: Hold for security design
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until secops specifies the exact writable-workspace and custom-bind boundary.

options.title: Reject writable `none`
options.body: If security owners decide `none` must remain no-write, update the issue and docs to make that explicit and keep writable custom bind work separate.

recommendation.title: Approve isolated writable `none`
recommendation.body: Implement writable sandbox-owned `/workspace` for `none`, with Docker/browser/remote bridge parity, protected-skill preservation, docs/tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the clearest maintainer direction on the related strict-gate PR and is tied to the original read-only behavior and shared sandbox plumbing.
